title: Warming Russian Baked Eggs
description: A warm and comforting breakfast recipe featuring baked eggs and a hint of Russian spices.
instructions: In a small bowl, whisk together warming spice blend and egg yolks.
In a separate bowl, beat egg whites until stiff peaks form.
In a greased 8-inch baking dish, create a layer of light.
Pour the whisked egg yolks over the light layer.
Gently fold in the beaten egg whites.
Bake for 25-30 minutes or until the eggs are set and the bake is golden brown.
Remove from oven and let cool for a few minutes.
